_comment: This file is intentionally EMPTY. BMW-specific DTC descriptions for the
F10 have not been sourced, and a wrong description is worse than none:
it sends someone to replace the wrong part.
When a code is not present here, the tool prints
'Description: Unknown BMW DTC' and shows the raw bytes. It must never
guess a description from a similar-looking code.

_schema.code: DTC as reported by the ECU, hex string (required)
